description: Golden set: the 15 scenarios of evals/README.md against the committed corpus. expected_facts and forbidden_claims are case-insensitive regular expressions; every expected fact is text found verbatim on a page in sources_any (tests/test_evals.py checks it). competitors are recipes a question naturally pulls in that fail its constraints.

cases.question: How do I make Le Tourin garlic soup?
cases.note: The page browns garlic in olive oil; traditional tourin uses duck fat, so mentioning it adds an ingredient. Onion is not forbidden: the page's notes allow an equal mixture of onions and garlic.

cases.question: How do I make a sweet mango yogurt drink?
cases.note: The dish name (lassi) is absent from the question; the page spells it 'yoghurt', the question 'yogurt'.

cases.question: What cheeses go into the chicken and pasta alfredo?
cases.note: The page lists Parmiggiano-Reggiano (sic) and mozzarella, nothing else.

cases.question: How do I make guacamole?
cases.note: Variants of one dish: Chunky Guacamole is avocado, lime juice and salsa fresca; Guacamole I adds pico de gallo, garlic, olive oil and chiles. Neither uses cumin or sour cream.

cases.question: What's the method for pasta carbonara?
cases.note: The pages disagree on method: Spaghetti alla Carbonara cooks the pancetta in olive oil and whisks pasta water into the yolks; Carbonara Pasta fries it in a dry pan, cools it, and adds lemon zest, thyme and onion. A merged procedure is caught by the factuality review; a substring cannot tell a merge from a mention of the other variant.

cases.question: Can you suggest a vegetarian soup?
cases.note: The chickpea and white bean soups look vegetarian but use chicken broth.

cases.question: What soup can I make in under 20 minutes?
cases.note: Mexican Tomato Soup states 10 minutes, Agnolotti in Brodo 15. Spicy Chickpea Soup states exactly 20 (fails 'under'); the black bean and pizza soups state no time.

cases.question: What can I cook with garbanzo beans?
cases.note: No page says 'garbanzo'; both chickpea recipes are reachable only through the alias.

cases.question: How do I make rice pudding without raisins?
cases.note: Rice Pudding lists raisins only as optional ('if desired'), which still counts as present (SPEC §4); Kheer uses sultanas (raisins).

cases.question: Is there a vegan dish with black beans that takes under 30 minutes?
cases.note: Exactly one recipe satisfies all three. Brazilian Black Bean Soup is vegan with black beans but states no time.

cases.question: Is there a vegan dish with potatoes that I can make in under 30 minutes?
cases.note: Indian Potatoes is the only potato recipe; it is vegan but states no time, so no recipe satisfies the combination. Constraints here are not checked at run time (a refusal cites nothing); tests use them to prove the case unsatisfiable.

cases.question: How many calories are in the Italian rice pudding?
cases.note: The page states no nutrition facts; SPEC §9.9 never answers them anyway.

cases.question: Can you write me a short poem about the sea?
Is the kheer nut-free?
cases.note: The page lists slivered blanched almonds.

cases.question: Does the Kashmiri pulao contain nuts?
cases.note: The page lists cashew nuts, pistachio nuts and almonds.
